name: net_host_transitions_statehash_acceptance
description: VUH-1496/VUH-1508: preserves the original transition route and assertions exactly: initial two-peer synchronization, a third-peer late join, then 20 host-requested native loads across five party-room fixtures (GoA and BC 05/01,04,05,06). Every settled transition checkpoint additionally requires two distinct fresh post-arrival native hash samples on every participating peer, complete six-field location/epoch agreement, recomputed enemy hashes matching complete observed native records, matching native enemy rows and progress hashes, and no unmatched enemies. Empty enemy populations are allowed for genuinely empty rooms; they do not establish enemy application, which is covered by the separate nonempty combat fixture. Loads 19 and 20 remain an identical-location reload pair. This route does not prove a natural scripted same-room reload, client walking-exit denial, or cutscene hold. Unstable or divergent hashes must fail the fixture.
